_comment: What the agent may do on its own. 'auto' = done without asking, 'draft' = prepared and shown on the dashboard for a human, 'off' = never.
commentHeader: (robot) *AI analysis* — automated first analysis. Please verify before acting on it.
_supersededComment: allowSupersededTestUpdates = a change request that deliberately replaces an earlier ticket's behaviour (analysis.supersedes, e.g. DEM-33 red instead of DEM-32 blue) may update ONLY the e2e tests of those tickets; the watcher checks it, and the PR, the Jira comment and the AI review call it out. false = the fix never touches tests.
_proposeFixWhenComment: A title without [FE] still qualifies when every file the analysis names is under frontend/ (inferTagFromFiles).
_fixComment: proposeFix = reproduce with a browser test, fix on branch <KEY>, verify independently, open a DRAFT pull request. mergeFix is always off: a human merges.
_reviewComment: reviewFix = after a draft PR is opened, a second read-only agent reviews it and posts a COMMENT review with a risk level (it never approves or merges).
_documentComment: documentOnDone = when a ticket the agent analyzed moves to Done, write docs/knowledge on branch docs/<KEY> and open a DRAFT pull request.
